from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document for cause-of-action sorting."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document title or identifier (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action, charge, or dispute type identified in the document")
    proceeding_type: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the proceeding: 'Civil', 'Criminal', 'Administrative', 'Execution'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
